title: Direct listener probe
description: The answer of GET /v1/engine on the engine's direct listener (CONTRACT.md, Direct transport). Public and untrusted on its own: the portal's pin page shows its fingerprint for the person to compare by hand, and every DIRECT session checks the key again in the handshake. A reader refuses an engineId that is not the engine id of engineKey.

engineKey.description: The engine's signing public key: the 91-byte DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo (id-ecPublicKey, prime256v1, uncompressed point), base64url without padding.

engineId.description: base64url of the first 16 bytes of sha256 of the SPKI DER (CONTRACT.md, Engine keys).
